definition: [ רֶ֫פֶת ] noun [masculine] apparently stable, stall (Late Hebrew id. ; √ dubious; Thes from רפף , compare Arabic enclosure for sheep and goats , but no satisfactory meaning of רפף known); — plural רְפָתִים Hab 3:17 (for cattle). רָץ see רוץ . [ רַץ ] see רצץ .
